answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must lock stake in a verification tree where each leaf is hard to crack like a walnut shell. Validating identities requires cryptographic stake burning across a tier structure; as an adversary attempts to forge multiple identities, the burned stake scales superlinearly according to an exponential curve $O(k^{1.5})$. This economic friction establishes an unscalable mesa of cost that makes mass identity fabrication impossible.
